steps.title: AI-Powered Operations
steps.text: The Model Context Protocol enables AI assistants to interact with Surgewave using natural language commands, conversational debugging, and automated remediation.

steps.title: MCP Architecture
steps.text: AI assistants communicate via JSON-RPC to an MCP server that exposes tools, resources, and prompts. The server translates tool invocations into Surgewave client operations.

steps.title: MCP Core Concepts
steps.text: Tools are functions the AI can invoke. Resources are data it can read. Prompts are templates for common operations. Transport can be stdio or HTTP/SSE.

steps.title: Use Cases
steps.text: Natural language operations, automated monitoring agents, data exploration, workflow automation, and intelligent message routing all become possible with Surgewave MCP integration.

steps.title: Best Practices
steps.text: Secure your MCP server with authentication, limit tool permissions, log all invocations for audit trails, rate limit AI operations, and validate all inputs.
